name: World Ender
desc: Aatrox gains Attack Damage equal to Varies% of his Omnivamp. On first death, he becomes briefly untargetable and heals back to full Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, he reduces his maximum Mana by 10 and gains 20% Durability.

name: Star Forger
desc: Aurelion Sol gains 25%/30%/100% increased Stardust for each other unique Targonian fielded in combat. Current Bonus: Varies%

name: Riftscourge
desc: Baron Nashor takes up 2 team slots and grants +2 to the Void trait. After 8 seconds, the board enters a Void Rift. The Rift grants Void units 30% Damage Amp and constantly strikes enemies with bolts of plasma, dealing 5% max Health as magic damage.

name: Bilgewater
desc: Each player combat, gain Silver Serpents (%i:scaleSerpents%), plus 1 additional for each Bilgewater takedown. Silver Serpents can be spent in the Black Market to grant Bilgewater champions bonus stats and special loot. Higher tiers unlock rarer loot. (Varies) 15 %i:scaleSerpents% (Varies) 15 %i:scaleSerpents%, improved loot (Varies) 15 %i:scaleSerpents%, superior loot (Varies) 15 %i:scaleSerpents%, 1x stats, FIRE CANNONS! Current Bonus Stats: Varies% ADAP, Varies% Attack Speed, Varies% Health Current Serpents: Varies %i:scaleSerpents%

name: Blacksmith
desc: After each player combat your strongest Ornn participates in, he makes progress forging an Artifact item. Each item he is equipped with grants him 350/600/2000 max Health. Artifacts grant 300% more. Forging Progress: Varies/4

name: Bruiser
desc: Your team gains 150 maximum Health. Bruisers gain more. (Varies) 25% Health

name: Caretaker
desc: After winning player combat, gain a random unit from Runeterra. After losing combat, gain free rerolls, with the amount increasing by stage. Rerolls on Loss: 2

name: Chronokeeper
desc: Every 2 casts, the Chronokeeper stores 1 XP. If he has enough stored for you to level up, he transfers you the required XP. If you are level 10, he instead gains 15% Damage Amp. Stored XP: Varies

name: Dark Child
desc: Annie summons Tibbers on your bench. He can be fielded, takes up a team slot, and can be equipped with items separately. His star level is the same as Annie's.

name: Darkin
desc: (Varies) Darkin gain 15% Omnivamp. (Varies) AND you heal for 25% of the player damage you deal. (Varies) AND whenever Darkin restore 600 Health, they deal 333 magic damage to the 2 closest enemies.

name: Defender
desc: Your team gains 12 Armor and Magic Resist. Defenders gain more. (Varies) 30 ArmorMagic Resist

name: Demacia
desc: Each time your team loses 25% max Health, Demacians Rally, reducing their Mana cost by 10%. Demacians gain Armor and Magic Resist. (Varies) 12 ArmorMagic Resist (Varies) 12 ArmorMagic Resist (Varies) 12 ArmorMagic Resist. On Rally, smite enemies for 5% of their max Health. (Varies) 12 ArmorMagic Resist. BATTLE FOR DEMACIA!

name: Emperor
desc: Azir deploys two Guards who can be placed anywhere on the battlefield. They do not move or attack, and die when Azir does.

name: Ixtal
desc: (Varies) Complete Quests to earn Sunshards (%i:Set16Ixtal%) and spend them for loot! (Varies) Heal 2 player health at the start of each player combat. (Varies) After winning combat, find 50 %i:Set16Ixtal% and unearth bonus loot. Completing a Quest before combat ends grants you a new one at the start of next round.

name: Freljord
desc: Summon a Frozen Tower. Allies in front of it gain Health and allies behind it gain Damage Amp. Freljordians gain 150% more. (Varies) 8% Health, 10% Damage Amp (Varies) Two Towers. 8% Health, 10% Damage Amp (Varies) Towers stun enemies on death for 1.5 seconds. 8% Health, 10% Damage Amp.

name: Glutton
desc: Once per Planning phase, you can feed Tahm Kench a champion, permanently granting him either Health, Attack Speed, or Ability Power based on their role and star level. To feed, hold an ally from the bench over Tahm Kench until his mouth opens, then release. Current Stats: Varies Health, Varies% Attack Speed, Varies% AP

name: Gunslinger
desc: Gunslingers gain Attack Damage. Every 4th attack from Gunslingers deals bonus physical damage. (Varies) 22% AD, 100 bonus damage

name: Harvester
desc: Each time an enemy champion dies, gain 10 Mana. Casting abilities does not consume Mana. All enemies lose 10 Armor and Magic Resist.

name: Heroic
desc: Galio cannot be fielded in combat. Instead, his traits count from the bench and when Demacians Rally, he joins the fight. On landing, he creates a 3-hex shockwave that deals 10% of his max Health as magic damage. Enemies hit are knocked up for 1 seconds, reduced by distance from the center.

name: HexMech
desc: Gain a Pilot Hex. Combat Start: the unit within jumps into T-Hex, granting her 80% of their Health and bonus stats based on their role and star level. Tank: +20/30/40% Omnivamp Fighter: +20/30/40% Attack Damage Marksman: +12/20/30% Damage Amp Caster: +2/4/5 Mana Regen Assassin: +40/70/100% Crit Chance On death, the pilot ejects while T-Hex knocks back and Stuns nearby enemies for 1.5 seconds.

name: Huntress
desc: While your strongest Neeko is alive, your strongest Nidalee cannot be targeted by basic attacks and gains 50% Durability.

name: Invoker
desc: Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. Invokers gain more Mana from all sources. (Varies) 25% more Mana

name: Ionia
desc: Ionians gain Shield, Attack Damage, and Ability Power. Each game, they walk a different path. (Varies) Gain a benefit that changes each game (Varies) Gain a benefit that changes each game (Varies) Gain a benefit that changes each game

name: Juggernaut
desc: Juggernauts gain Durability, increased while above 50% health. When a Juggernaut dies, other Juggernauts heal for 5% of their max Health. (Varies) 18% or 25% Durability

name: Assimilator
desc: Kai'Sa has a different Ability depending if her Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher.

name: Eternal
desc: Every 3rd attack from Kindred on the same enemy deals 325% damage, as Wolf mauls their target.

name: Longshot
desc: Longshots gain Damage Amp and deal more damage to targets farther away. (Varies) 18% Damage Amp + 2% per Hex

name: Disruptor
desc: Disruptors' abilities Dazzle enemies hit. Disruptors deal bonus damage to Dazzled enemies. (Varies) 18% bonus damage Dazzle: Reduce damage dealt by 10%

name: Noxus
desc: After the enemy team has lost 15% of their Health, summon Atakhan, Bringer of Ruin. Each Noxian champion's star level increases his power. (Varies) He slashes enemies, dealing magic damage. (Varies) Noxians get more powerful the longer he is alive. (Varies) He drains the souls of enemies on cast. (Varies) After 10 seconds, BRING RUIN.

name: Piltover
desc: Build an invention on the right side of the board. After 8 seconds, the invention activates, triggering each of its Modules. (Varies) Choose a Module (Varies) Choose a Second Module (Varies) Choose a Third Module

name: Quickstriker
desc: Your team gains 15% Attack Speed. Quickstrikers gain bonus Attack Speed based on their target's missing Health. (Varies) 10%-30% Attack Speed (Varies) 10%-30% Attack Speed (Varies) 10%-30% Attack Speed (Varies) 10%-30% Attack Speed

name: Rune Mage
desc: The Rune Mage benefits from all active Region traits, but contributes to none. He harnesses the Runic power from active Region traits to modify his Ability, enhancing it in unique ways.

name: Shadow Isles
desc: Whenever ANY champion dies in a player combat, gain Souls (%i:scaleSouls%). Shadow Isles champions' Abilities are uniquely empowered based on the number of Souls you have. Shadow Isles champions gain Attack Damage and Ability Power. (Varies) 1x %i:scaleSouls%, 18% ADAP (Varies) 1x %i:scaleSouls%, 18% ADAP (Varies) 1x %i:scaleSouls%, 18% ADAP (Varies) 1x %i:scaleSouls%, 18% ADAP Souls Collected: Varies %i:scaleSouls%

name: Shurima
desc: Each second, Shurimans gain 2% Attack Speed and restore 20 Health. At combat start, they gain additional effects. (Varies) 20% max Health (Varies) 50 Armor and Magic Resist (Varies) A Shuriman ascends to GODHOOD every 3 seconds.

name: Dragonborn
desc: On cast, Shyvana replaces her spell with Flame Breath. While transformed, all allies take 8% less damage from enemy Abilities.

name: Slayer
desc: Slayers gain Omnivamp and Attack Damage. They increase the bonus Attack Damage by up to 50% based on their missing Health. (Varies) 22% AD, 10% Omnivamp

name: Arcanist
desc: Your team gains Ability Power, Arcanists gain more. (Varies) 18% AP, 25% AP for Arcanists

name: Soulbound
desc: Lucian and Senna fight together, swapping when either casts. Each champion has a unique ability. Your strongest Soulbound pair grants bonuses to your team while they survive. While Senna is out, all allies gain 7% Damage Reduction. While Lucian is out, all allies gain 7% Damage Amp.

name: Chainbreaker
desc: Sylas rotates between 3 different Abilities, depending on which one is most useful at the moment. He cannot cast the same one twice in a row.

name: Targon
desc: Targonians are forged by the stars. They are traitless, but stronger than the average champion.

name: Chosen Wolves
desc: When Kindred casts, Ambessa always gains their protection against death and gains 40% Attack Damage while protected. When Ambessa casts, Wolf strikes all enemies hit, dealing 30% damage.

name: Timewinders
desc: After every combat Ekko participates in, gain 2XP. After 3-starring Ekko, gain a Zilean. Ekko's empowered attacks echo for 10% of the original damage to all enemies taking damage from your strongest Zilean.

name: Dragonguards
desc: When Jarvan casts, Shyvana gains 100% of the Shield. When Shyvana casts, Jarvan jumps in and deals 100%/120%/155%/200% of his Armor and Magic Resist as magic damage in a 2-hex radius.

name: Sentinels of Light
desc: When Vayne casts on an enemy afflicted with Black Mist, she fires 2 extra bolts at 25% effectiveness. When she gets a takedown, Lucian and Senna gain 50% Attack Speed.

name: Poison Pals
desc: Gain a 2-star Teemo. Singed's damage refreshes Teemo's poisons and Teemo's damage grants Singed ramping Ability Power. Gain a Teemo after each player combat.

name: The Boss
desc: When Sett first drops below 45% max Health, he leaves combat to start doing sit-ups. Each sit-up restores 15% max Health and gives him 60% Attack and Move Speed. If he reaches full Health, he returns to combat Pumped Up, converting all damage from his attacks and Ability to true damage. If all of his allies die, he immediately returns to combat.

name: Vanquisher
desc: Vanquishers' abilities can critically strike. They also gain Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage. (Varies) 15% Crit Chance , 15% Crit Damage

name: Void
desc: Gain Mutations that only Void champions can use. Void champions gain Attack Speed. (Varies) 1 Mutation, 8% Attack Speed (Varies) 1 Mutations, 8% Attack Speed (Varies) 1 Mutations, 8% Attack Speed (Varies) Mutations become supercharged, increasing their power by 100%. 8% Attack Speed Champions can only have one Mutation at a time. Benching a champion removes their Mutation.

name: Warden
desc: When Wardens first drop below 75% and 25% Health, they gain a Shield based on their max Health. (Varies) 16% Health

name: Ascendant
desc: After each combat, an Ascendant Charm appears in your shop. These are powerful effects that can be bought for gold.

name: Yordle
desc: (Varies) Yordles gain 40 Health and 5% Attack Speed for each unique Yordle fielded. 3 star Yordles grant 100% more! (Varies) AND your first shop each round has a Yordle in it! (Varies) AND get 1 free rerolls each round! (Varies) AND get a Yordle Grab Bag each round!

name: Immortal
desc: While Xin Zhao is not on your board, Zaahen gains the Ionia, Demacia, and Warden traits. On kill, Zaahen gains a stack of Determination for the rest of combat. If he has 3 or more Determination when dying, he spends it to revive and restore 60% max Health.

name: Zaun
desc: After 4 seconds, Zaunites become Shimmer-Fused , granting them 15% Durability and 90% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds. After a short cooldown, they become Shimmer-Fused again. (Varies) Refresh after 4 seconds. (Varies) At 60% Health, Zaunites restore 30% Health over 3 seconds and instantly become Shimmer-Fused. (Varies) Shimmer-Fused bonuses are increased by 50%. Refresh after 4 seconds instead.
